argument:
Apple combines positive comparable revenue/profit growth, substantial FCF and falling reported debt with a constructive price trend. The technical report places price above SMA50 and SMA200 with positive MACD, so the purchase case can rest on profitable growth and demonstrated relative strength rather than waiting for an uncertain deep discount.

Inference: a modest trend-following position could participate if that strength persists. Missing authenticated valuation limits conviction, and the service incident has no verified durable financial loss; neither fact establishes a broken business.
key_points: Positive comparable revenue and profit growth
Strong positive FCF with declining debt
Price above SMA50/SMA200 and positive MACD
